title: The Interrogation, The Redactor & The Dream of Thanatos
overview: Tucked away in a university arcade, the party interrogates their captive Redactor operative, discovering that the mysterious 'Master' is curating a utopian timeline and that the party members themselves have become living anomaly vessels targeted for elimination. When the captive mocks Alfie, the driftwood duelist executes her with a needle rapier through the skull, triggering a blinding violet signal flare that draws an ink-cloaked, six-fingered stalker. Fleeing into the misty Lost Roads behind Pierre's luminous rabbit patronus, the company encounters and rescues Susanna, the museum worker lost since Raleigh. At The Margin, morale rebounds over rum-infused griddle pancakes as Alfie reveals four centuries of thread memory, Eusacles receives a nocturnal visitation and divine armor blessing from his father Thanatos, and Naomi outlines their next high-stakes target: an evidence locker in the heart of Washington, D.C.

narrative_acts.title: The Cart Interrogation & Alfie's Execution
narrative_acts.summary: Tucked beneath an arcade where modern university brick meets the misty fringe of the Lost Roads, Pierre, Alfie, and Eusacles interrogate their bound captive inside a rubberized janitor cart. The woman reveals the chilling doctrine of her 'Master': he is rewriting history to create an egalitarian, flaw-free utopia by erasing historical errors like Dr. Thorne's medical experiments. Crucially, she reveals that the Master no longer seeks physical relics because their temporal energy is now absorbed inside the party—making them living anomaly vessels marked for death. When she insults Alfie as disposable driftwood junk, Alfie calmly states that he is filled with memories of bad men and drives his sewing-needle rapier through her skull. As Pierre retches into the campus hedges, the dying woman's brain unleashes a brilliant violet flare into the night sky, acting as an arcane beacon alerting planar trackers.

narrative_acts.title: The Six-Fingered Stalker & The Rabbit Patronus
narrative_acts.summary: The violet beacon draws an immediate predator across the quad: a footless, ink-cloaked entity drifting over the grass with six twitching fingers and dozens of drowned, shifting human faces churning beneath translucent skin. Sensing the horrifying predator tracking their scent, Eusacles and Alfie lead a frantic retreat toward the tree line. Lingering at the threshold seam, Pierre is spotted by the multi-faced watcher. In blind panic, Pierre snaps his fingers and channels his dormant heritage, accidentally manifesting a dazzling, luminous white hare that bounds across the lawn in playful loops. Momentarily transfixing the dread stalker, the distraction allows Pierre to dive through the spatial fold into the safety of the Lost Roads.

narrative_acts.title: The Lost Roads, Susanna's Rescue & Return to Sanctuary
narrative_acts.summary: Traversing the perpetual twilight of the Lost Roads, the company is startled when a disheveled woman crashes through the ferns: Susanna, the innocent museum attendant from the North Carolina Museum of Natural History, who had been lost wandering the temporal mists for weeks after escaping petrification. Pierre greets her with theatrical Parisian charm ('You know that would make me your angel'), while Alfie shows off his souvenir museum cap. Harvesting ripe wild blackberries and golden plums along the mossy verge, the party guides Susanna safely out of the fog onto the sunlit grounds of The Margin. On the porch, Eusacles uses divine Mending to repair Pierre's snapped bronze javelin, restoring the party's two-man pancake-flipping technique, while Teddy listens to their report in grim silence.

narrative_acts.title: Rum Pancakes, The Two-Fragment Curse & Four Centuries of Memory
narrative_acts.summary: Examining the severed rubbery tendril Alfie took as a trophy, Teddy blanches and confesses a long-buried truth: the six-fingered stalker is the Redactor, and it hunted Teddy decades ago because touching two fragments permanently curses a traveler to be tracked outside the sanctuary. Despite the looming threat, domestic comfort restores morale. Mike prepares a mountain of golden flapjacks drenched in rum-infused berry jam, and Alfie downs a massive shot glass of dark liquor. Tipsy and swaggering across the porch like an old sea captain, Alfie announces he has murdered someone, then reveals a profound ontological truth: while he walked the earth for only four days, he carries 458 years of collective memory from the drowned sailor cloaks that form his body. Recognizing his trauma, Rosa gently leads Alfie to her studio for counseling.

narrative_acts.title: The Dream of Thanatos, The Pancake Duel & The Washington Directive
narrative_acts.summary: Past midnight, Thanatos visits Eusacles in a silver campfire dream. The demigod confronts his absentee father, asking for armor rather than cosmic answers. Inscribing glowing sigils onto Eusacles' pocket watch, Thanatos grants his Tier 2 Birthright: grave-ward armor that hardens his skin whenever mortally pressed. When Eusacles inquires about Pierre's mother, Thanatos bursts into booming laughter, calling it an epic prank and asking if Hermes noticed. At dawn breakfast, tensions erupt comically when Eusacles casts Divine Flavor on Pierre's plain pancakes; outraged by the culinary desecration, Pierre shanks Eusacles in the ribs with his mended bronze spear, heals and stitches the wound with rum, and demands proper butter. Naomi then drops their next mission: an anomalous 1980s airliner hijacking whose evidence is locked in a Washington, D.C. police precinct. Following rigorous push-up drills in the courtyard led by Alfie, the party gears up, ready to infiltrate the mortal capital.

dramatis_personae_notes.pierre: Horrified by Alfie's cold violence, bluffs the six-fingered stalker with an accidental rabbit patronus, flirts with Susanna in the mist, shanks Eusacles over pancake ingredients, and is trained in push-ups by Alfie.
dramatis_personae_notes.alfie: Executes the captive through the nostril without flinching, reveals 458 years of accumulated thread memory, gets hammered on Mike's rum pancakes, diagnoses the plot using Harry Potter, and drills Pierre on the lawn.
dramatis_personae_notes.eusacles: Pragmatic frontline anchor; mends Pierre's bronze javelin with prayer, receives Tier 2 grave armor on his pocket watch from father Thanatos, survives Pierre's culinary stabbing, and parries spear thrusts.
dramatis_personae_notes.dravin: Absent from active scenes; conducting independent archival research in university history stacks on Dr. Thorne's altered 1948 trial ledger.
dramatis_personae_notes.teddy: Margin Caretaker; reveals his own dark history with the Six-Fingered Redactor Stalker and the curse of touching two fragments.
dramatis_personae_notes.naomi: Strategic coordinator; debriefs the party on the podcast investigation of the D.C. airliner anomaly and preps precinct schematics.
dramatis_personae_notes.mike: Lost Roads gatekeeper; cooks rum-infused flapjacks, mixes rum jam, and assists in the two-man pancake spatula flip.
dramatis_personae_notes.rosa: Cabin matron; provides gentle emotional and trauma de-escalation for Alfie following his brutal execution of the captive.
dramatis_personae_notes.susanna: Innocent civilian museum attendant from Raleigh; stumbled through the Lost Roads for weeks before being rescued and brought to sanctuary.
dramatis_personae_notes.thanatos: Greek God of Peaceful Death; visits Eusacles in a nocturnal dream, engraves protective watch armor, and laughs uproariously at Pierre's lineage.
dramatis_personae_notes.stalker: The Six-Fingered Redactor Stalker; a multi-faced, ink-cloaked planar hunter drawn by the purple death flare to track living anomaly vessels.

lore_discoveries.definition: Teddy reveals that touching two timeline fragments permanently brands a traveler, drawing the six-fingered, multi-faced Redactor Stalker to hunt them whenever they step outside The Margin.
The overarching philosophy of the timeline architect: systematically rewriting historical flaws and medical atrocities to forge an egalitarian, flaw-free world, regardless of paradoxes.
The critical revelation that physical contact with fragments infuses mortals with temporal resonance; the party members themselves are now the primary targets of Redactor erasure.
A 1980s commercial airliner flight bound for Washington, D.C. where an armed hijacker was spontaneously neutralized and zip-tied without any passengers seeing who did it.
The Greek God of Peaceful Death operates apart from Olympus and Hades as an independent cosmic arbiter, granting Eusacles grave-ward armor on his pocket watch.

milestones: Interrogating the captive reveals the Master's utopian ideology and the party's status as living anomaly vessels.
Alfie executes the captive through the nostril, unleashing a violet signal flare that alerts planar hunters.
Pierre manifests an accidental radiant white rabbit patronus to distract the multi-faced six-fingered stalker.
The party encounters and rescues Susanna, the lost NC museum attendant, escorting her safely to The Margin.
Teddy confesses that touching two fragments curses travelers to be hunted by the Redactor Stalker outside the sanctuary.
Alfie reveals his 458-year collective thread consciousness over Mike's rum pancakes, seeking trauma counseling with Rosa.
Thanatos visits Eusacles in a campfire dream, conferring his Tier 2 Birthright watch ward and laughing at Pierre's parentage.
Pierre stabs Eusacles in culinary outrage over ruined pancakes before stitching the wound with rum as an antiseptic.
Naomi identifies the Washington, D.C. police evidence locker as their next target, launching dawn combat drills.

critic.highlights: Session 7 is a triumph of tonal balance. It pivots effortlessly between cold, visceral interrogation in a damp university arcade, eerie cosmic horror against a multi-faced stalker, warm domestic respite on a mountain porch, high mythic communion with the God of Death, and completely unhinged culinary slapstick. Alfie's nostril execution and subsequent 458-year thread confession cement him as the dramatic heart of the campaign, while Pierre and Eusacles' dynamic balances genuine vulnerability with laugh-out-loud comedy.
critic.threads_audit:
- **Advanced:** `TH-01` (Alfie's Origin) — 458 years of drowned sailor memories revealed.
- **Opened:** `TH-05` (The Six-Fingered Redactor Stalker) — Identified as the curse stalking those who touch two fragments.
- **Opened (Active Hook):** `TH-06` (Washington D.C. Evidence Locker Expedition) — Naomi outlines the police precinct heist.
- **Advanced:** `TH-07` (The Nature of Timeline Fragments) — Party discovers they are living anomaly vessels.
- **Confirmed / Resolved:** `TH-08` (Eusacles' Engraved Watch) — Thanatos enchants watch and drops cryptic hints on Pierre's mother.

Pierre.growth: Pierre is undergoing a fascinating transition from a self-absorbed, neurotic French academic who hides behind his rucksack into an active moral guardian. His immediate instinct to shield Susanna, keep her safe from Naomi's interrogation gauntlet, and ensure she has warm food reveals genuine heart. However, his defense mechanism is still comical evasion—insisting his mother is an 'Italian mob boss' when challenged, and fainting into the bushes at genuine violence. Next step: lean into the cognitive dissonance between Pierre's delicate domestic aspirations (croissants, clean berets, wine) and his terrifying primordial monstrous heritage. As the party prepares to infiltrate a mortal police precinct in Washington, D.C., how will Pierre handle the truth when he finally discovers why the God of Death found his mother so hilarious?
Pierre.chirp: Let's review the tape: Pierre literally vomited in the campus boxwood hedges because Alfie gave a Redactor a fatal nosebleed, but two hours later he shanks his demigod teammate in the kidney with a bronze spear because Eusacles cast Divine Flavor on his flapjacks? Absolutely unhinged culinary priorities. And Pierre, my brother in Christ, nobody on the Eastern Seaboard believes your mother is an Italian mafia don. You are an archaeology intern with a beret and a pocket full of blueberry jam. Work on your intimidation face before we hit D.C., because the Metropolitan Police aren't going to be cowed by an accidental glowing rabbit.

Alfie.growth: Alfie delivered an absolute masterclass this session. The contrast between his newborn, wide-eyed wonder at mortal life (eating pancakes and jam for the first time, asking if police stations have gift shops and merch) and his chilling, centuries-old nautical violence is the emotional core of the campaign. When Alfie calmly states 'I'm filled with memories of really bad men, so it's fine' before executing the captive through the nostril, Sophie establishes Alfie as an ancient soul carrying heavy trauma in a tiny wooden frame. Next step: explore the boundary between Alfie's borrowed thread memories (458 years of drowned sailors' garments) and his own emergent identity that has only walked the earth for four days. Does Alfie want to be an action figure, a duelist, or something entirely his own?
Alfie.chirp: A two-foot driftwood action figure who downs a shot glass of dark rum the size of a ceremonial baptismal font, staggers onto the porch slurring 'I murdered someone earlier!' to the local commune, and then explains the entire campaign cosmology using Harry Potter Horcrux lore is peak tabletop energy. Just make sure someone holds his hand in Washington, D.C., or the entire party's emergency funds are going directly into novelty FBI windbreakers and souvenir snowglobes.

Eusacles.growth: Eusacles continues to be the pragmatic, unflinching anchor of the group. His nocturnal communion with his estranged father Thanatos is a major milestone: moving from a bitter, abandoned kid ('You've missed a lot of birthdays') to accepting his demigod heritage and earning his Tier 2 Birthright. The pocket-watch warding armor gives him a mechanical and narrative identity as Death's favored son in denim. Next step: Eusacles is terrified of the 'hero' label because he knows Greek tragedies always end in slaughter. As the stakes escalate toward federal jurisdiction in D.C., challenge Eusacles to step into genuine moral leadership rather than just reactive survival. He has the ear of Death himself—what kind of legacy does he actually want to build?
Eusacles.chirp: Eusacles finally gets a sit-down with his deadbeat father, the literal Greek God of Peaceful Death, and instead of asking about cosmic redemption, why planar tears are opening, or why dad never showed up to Little League, he basically asks for better dental coverage and a defensive gear buff. Classic John. And the ink isn't even dry on Thanatos' divine blessing before Eusacles gets impaled by his own baker over breakfast! At least the watch parry works. Next time, just let Pierre have his unsalted butter.

Dravin.growth: [NO DATA - ABSENT] Professor Dravin was absent from the active table, justified in fiction as conducting deep archival research in university library stacks on Dr. Thorne's altered 1948 trial notes.
Dravin.chirp: Professor, you missed ONE session and your party: executed a prisoner in a janitor cart, picked wild blueberries with a lost museum clerk, got tipsy on rum pancakes, stabbed each other over culinary seasoning, and held an impromptu push-up boot camp on the lawn. Hurry back from the library before Pierre sells your tweed coat to buy croissant yeast.

critic.gm_craft: Thanatos was portrayed with perfection—not an ominous grim reaper, but a tired, amused celestial bureaucrat with genuine love for his son. Grounding the six-fingered stalker into Teddy's backstory transformed a random encounter into deep campaign lore.
bets: Bet #1: The Washington D.C. evidence locker contains anomalous flight records and handcuffs that react violently when brought into contact with Pierre or Eusacles.
Bet #2: Pierre's mother is Echidna, the Mother of Monsters, and Thanatos laughed because Hermes and the gods consider hiding her son in an American college a cosmic prank.
